docs.title: Explore by Domain
docs.text: 🔤 Terminologies & Vocabularies 16 datasets - Code systems, vocabularies, and ontology sources for semantic normalization. 🏥 CMS / Medicare 11 datasets - Medicare, quality, payment, enrollment, and federal provider datasets. 🤝 Medicaid 1 datasets - Medicaid and CHIP files for access, cost, eligibility, and utilization analysis. 📊 CDC Surveillance & Public Health 16 datasets - Public health surveillance, surveys, registries, and vital statistics. 🏨 HCUP 4 datasets - Encounter-level inpatient, emergency, and ambulatory surgery research assets. 💳 Claims, Cost & Transparency 7 datasets - Commercial claims, APCDs, price transparency, and state encounter files. 🧑‍⚕️ Provider Data 6 datasets - Provider directories, taxonomy files, quality measures, and relationship data. 🏘️ SDOH & Environment 13 datasets - Social, economic, environmental, housing, workforce, and place-based context. 🗺️ Census & Demographic 5 datasets - Population, insurance, poverty, commuting, and denominator datasets. 🔬 Clinical / Research / ICU 10 datasets - Credentialed EHR, ICU, cohort, trial, and multimodal research datasets. 💊 Drug & Pharmacology 7 datasets - Drug labels, approvals, adverse events, compounds, side effects, and safety data. 🖼️ Imaging 5 datasets - Radiology, dermatology, cancer imaging, and benchmark medical image collections. 🧬 Genomics / Phenotype 3 datasets - Variant, phenotype, ontology, and association resources for genetics workflows. 🌐 International / Global Health 4 datasets - Global and country-comparable health indicators, burden, and system measures.

docs.title: Getting started
docs.text:
1. Pick a use case under use-cases/.
  2. Filter datasets by access tier and PHI posture.
  3. Prototype ETL on open/synthetic data.
  4. Apply for governed data only after the cohort, target, validation plan, and security posture are clear.
  5. Map vocabularies and fact tables into OMOP/PCORnet when reuse or multi-source validation matters.

Useful commands:

pip install -r requirements.txt
python scripts/validate.py
python scripts/build_readme.py
python scripts/build_csv.py
python scripts/build_search_index.py

docs.title: PHI and re-identification guide
docs.text:
The catalog records PHI posture, but it is not legal advice. Treat these as acquisition-planning signals:

  • Open aggregate datasets can still create small-cell disclosure risk after joins.
  • De-identified clinical and imaging datasets can retain re-identification risk through dates, rare conditions, longitudinal detail, images, or genomics.
  • Limited Data Sets and Research Identifiable Files require policy, technical, and contractual controls.
  • Model outputs can leak protected facts; validate suppression rules for dashboards and reports.

docs.title: Research method
docs.text:
This scaffold follows the six-attribute diligence pattern used in the source research:

  1. Access tier and licensing.
  2. Grain, schema, and identifiers.
  3. Coverage, size, and representativeness.
  4. PHI, re-identification risk, and de-identification method.
  5. Known quality issues and analytical gotchas.
  6. Canonical ETL path, including OMOP/PCORnet mapping status.

Entries marked reference contain extra acquisition and ML guidance. Entries marked seed are schema-complete and intentionally ready for community review.
